rv.q: The evening flew by without a hitch, delivering an exciting and well-crafted theatrical experience.
The exquisite musical performances deliver all and more where the plot lacks depth.
The audience was enthralled with her vocal talents throughout the evening but the explosive, and I mean explosive final number knocked all of us out of our seats.
The tour is blessed with a phenomenally talented cast, and that covers for the fact that the script feels clunky at times.
I n Toledo, it's something special.
The official tour for the Whitney Houston jukebox musical "THE BODYGUARD" leaps onto stage at The Hanover Theatre for the Performing Arts in Worcester for one weekend only.
So What’s the Verdict Even with my criticisms, I enjoyed The Bodyguard .

cn.t: Critics find The Bodyguard more tribute concert than musical, with Whitney Houston's iconic songs drawing praise while the thin plot draws eye-rolls. Fans of the music will leave satisfied; those seeking theatrical depth may not.
